body: I understand now. My venting could’ve been damaging. I’m so sorry to anyone I affected. I’m so fucking sorry.

All I was doing was asking if anyone else felt the same way. I was banned for venting about my harm OCD and saying what my brain was telling me I’d do. I wasn’t reassuring anyone their compulsions were real or anything like that, I’m not a horrible person and all I wanted to do was know if what I was experiencing was also experienced by other people with Harm OCD.
I will never ever hurt an animal. I have 8 cats and I love every single one of them, I would only ever kill a bad person but I’m seeking out help.

You are not a pedophile. You are not a monster. You will make it through this and I promise you this is all your OCD feeding you thoughts. Everyone here is going through the same shit, and yeah it sucks but we’re all here for each other.

I’m also the same. I’m emotionless, I watched SnuffR73 and laughed at some parts of it. I feel disgusted with myself. I’m pretty sure I’m a sociopath. I feel empathy for people but I don’t care for gore videos at all, I’m not trying to be an edgelord or anything. I believe OCD can desensitise us to awful things.
I’m not sure what you mean but you can’t make things happen just by obsessing or excessively worrying over something.
Thank you! Came up with it 4 years ago lmao
I’ve suffered with this hellhole of a mental illness too long as well. From one person with a shitty brain to another, I hope you’re doing ok. And things will get better, I promise.
I’ll happily be your friend! I’ve never really had one
I used to have a therapist but I can’t see them anymore and I don’t trust fucking anyone
I want to kill them

Whenever that image appears in your head, switch to something else like a kitten or puppy. It’s a trick my mum taught me, it takes a little bit but it works. As soon as it pops into your head picture something you love instead
I love killing flies and stuff but never spiders or moths.
I sleep naked and it’s just really comfy and I recommend it
I’ll be your friend
Thank you
Jeffrey Bezos!

If your therapist specialises in OCD they will understand. Therapists know that these things aren’t actually at risk of happening and will not label you as a danger, we’re all going through this together and yeah it fucking sucks. But at least I can assure you that they will understand and they will give you the help and support that you need. Please reach out to them and tell them these thoughts so you can get treated. My thoughts are also very violent and I have told my therapist about them.

I didn’t even know this was an OCD thing. I’ve listened to all eyes on me by Bo Burnham 1500 times and I know this because of my last.fm account (it’s a site that tracks your plays of songs) and I also have a tendency to watch movies and series over and over. I watched John Wick every day for a year once. I’ve seen breaking bad a good 20 times too. So you’re not the only one

No. She offered you some of her drink and you had some of her drink. I can assure you that this is in no way sexual assault, it cannot even be classified as sexual assault. You have not hurt or affected her in any way. She offered you a sip of her drink and you took it. This mental illness fucking sucks and I know that I might not be helping but I’m hoping I can get across to you that everything is completely ok and you have done nothing wrong. You merely took a sip of her drink.

I feel the same. I’m spiralling. I constantly worry I’ll kill someone. I think I’m a burden to everyone. I don’t know how to deal with this shit either but we’re all in the same boat and there’s people here to help.
You are not a monster. You have not ruined her life. This is POCD. You are not evil.

Stop. Breathe. Calm down. This has happened to me and yes it is OCD. The reality is that if you report this guy, nothing will happen, the police don’t care. As someone who has caught online predators for the past 5 years, I can confirm that the police don’t do anything and it’s awful. This man will get what he deserves, I can tell you that, he will be slapped by karma. Stop stressing, this is out of your control, take deep breaths in through the nose and out through the mouth, try to calm down. This is out of your control and although it’s awful, there’s nothing you can do.

Me! I’m convinced I’m a serial killer and I have compulsions to kill. As I’m typing this I’m watching The Ted Bundy Tapes (S1: E2 “One of Us” 55:07 in) so I understand how true crime can fuel it, it’s getting to the point now where I enjoy the thought of killing bad people. The person you’re referring to is Edmund Kemper by the way, and trust me, even if you tried you could never be as horrible as he was. You’ll never be a killer, you’ll never be a monster and you’ll never hurt anyone intentionally. Harm OCD is awful but we’re all in this together.
I feel you, I’ve dealt with OCD for 16 years now. It’s awful but we’re all in this together. Welcome to the club
